import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from your_gui_module import YourGUIClass

class TestYourGUI(unittest.TestCase):

    @patch('your_gui_module.Controller.get_patient_pressure')
    def test_gui_displays_patient_pressure(self, mock_get_patient_pressure):
        mock_get_patient_pressure.return_value = 120  # Grounded value from SRS
        gui = YourGUIClass()
        gui.update_gui()
        self.assertEqual(gui.patient_pressure_display, 120)

    @patch('your_gui_module.Controller.get_volume_graph_data')
    def test_gui_graph_refresh_rate(self, mock_get_volume_graph_data):
        mock_get_volume_graph_data.return_value = [i for i in range(100)]  # Grounded value from SRS
        gui = YourGUIClass()
        start_time = time.time()
        for _ in range(20):
            gui.update_gui()
            time.sleep(0.05)
        end_time = time.time()
        self.assertLessEqual(end_time - start_time, 1.5)  # 20Hz refresh rate

    @patch('your_gui_module.Controller.get_volume_graph_data')
    def test_gui_graph_duration(self, mock_get_volume_graph_data):
        mock_get_volume_graph_data.return_value = [i for i in range(300)]  # Grounded value from SRS
        gui = YourGUIClass()
        start_time = time.time()
        while time.time() - start_time < 30:
            gui.update_gui()
            time.sleep(0.05)
        end_time = time.time()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(end_time - start_time, 29.5)  # 30 seconds duration

        mock_get_inspiratory_tidal_volume.return_value = 500  # Grounded value from SRS

        gui.update_gui()
        self.assertEqual(gui.tidal_volume_display, 500)

        self.assertEqual(gui.ratio_display, 15)

        self.assertEqual(gui.peep_display, 10)

        gui = YourGUIClass()
        gui.update_gui()
        self.assertEqual(gui.patient_pressure_display, "Invalid")

    unittest.main()
